A [Starts at maximum and completes four cycles by $2T$.]
B [Starts at maximum and completes two cycles by $2T$.]

perOption.A: Treats total energy as fixed and reverses both individual energy changes.
perOption.B: Gets both individual changes right but treats total energy as fixed.
perOption.C: Gets the total energy change right but reverses both individual changes.
